sections.title: Text 1

blocks.zh: 白家月：这里的老年人真不少。
blocks.en: Bai: There are many older people here.

blocks.zh: 李文：嗯，住在附近的老年人都会来这儿，有的散步，有的唱歌、跳舞，还有的打太极拳。
blocks.en: Li: Older people nearby come here. Some walk, some sing and dance, and others practise tai chi.

blocks.zh: 白家月：他们的生活真丰富，让人羡慕。
blocks.en: Bai: Their lives are so varied. I envy them.

blocks.zh: 李文：是的。有些人即使年龄大了，也坚持去老年班学习。
blocks.en: Li: Yes. Some keep attending classes even at an advanced age.

blocks.zh: 白家月：真是活到老学到老啊。
blocks.en: Bai: You are never too old to learn.

blocks.zh: 李文：对，我爷爷就每周都去老年班学电脑。他总说，老年人也要继续学习，“你看，我都七八十岁了，还上网和网友们聊天儿呢，生活一点儿都不无聊。”
blocks.en: Li: My grandfather studies computers every week. He says older people must keep learning: “I’m in my seventies or eighties and still chat with online friends. Life is not boring at all.”

blocks.zh: 在公园里，老年人都会做些什么活动？
blocks.en: What activities do older people do in the park?

answers.zh: 有的散步，有的唱歌、跳舞，还有的打太极拳。
answers.en: Some walk, sing or dance; others practise tai chi.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

blocks.zh: 李文的爷爷为什么去老年班学习？
blocks.en: Why does Li’s grandfather attend classes?

answers.zh: 因为他觉得老年人也要继续学习，生活才不无聊。
answers.en: He feels older people should keep learning so life is not boring.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

sections.note: Retell this text in your own words

prompt.zh: 李文和白家月在公园里散步。白家月觉得公园里的老年人……。李文说，住在附近的老年人都……，有的……，有的……、……，还有的……。白家月说，这里的老年人生活……，让人……。李文告诉她，有些老年人即使……，也坚持……。比如，他爷爷每周都去老年班……。爷爷说：“你看，我都……，还上网……呢，生活……。”
prompt.en: Li and Bai walk in the park. Bai thinks there are…. Nearby older people all…; some…, some…and…, and others…. Their lives are…and make her…. Even when…, some keep…. His grandfather studies…weekly. He says, “I am already…, but still…online; life….”

answer.zh: 李文和白家月在公园里散步。白家月觉得老年人很多，生活很丰富，让人羡慕。李文说，他们有的散步，有的唱歌、跳舞，还有的打太极拳。有些人即使年龄大了，也坚持学习。李文的爷爷每周去老年班学电脑。他都七八十岁了，还上网和网友聊天儿，生活一点儿都不无聊。
answer.en: Li and Bai walk in the park. Bai admires the many older people’s varied lives. Some walk, sing, dance or practise tai chi. Some keep learning despite their age. Li’s grandfather attends computer classes weekly and chats online in his seventies or eighties; he is never bored.

sections.title: Grammar 1 · 即使……也……

blocks.zh: 有些人即使年龄大了，也坚持去老年班学习。

blocks.zh: 即使明天下大雨，我们也会按时出发。

blocks.zh: A：门前的花长得真不错！B：是的，即使缺水，____。
blocks.en: A: The flowers are growing well! B: Yes, even without enough water,….

answers.en: they can still grow well

sections.intro: 即使 introduces an unfavourable or extreme hypothetical condition; 也 shows that the outcome or decision remains unchanged.

sections.title: Text 2

blocks.zh: 安妮：家月，我们今天的课是在数字教室上的，感觉挺不一样的。
blocks.en: Annie: Jiayue, our class in a digital classroom felt very different today.

blocks.zh: 白家月：是的，数字教室可以拍照点名，教授在线上点名，不用像线下那样一个个叫名字，特别节约时间。
blocks.en: Bai: Yes, it takes a picture to check attendance. The professor need not call names individually, saving time.

blocks.zh: 李文：最方便的是，课上没听明白时，课后还能在学校网站上找到视频记录看。
blocks.en: Li: Most conveniently, if you miss something, you can watch the recorded video on the school website later.

blocks.zh: 安妮：对，上课我都不用着急记笔记了。
blocks.en: Annie: Right. I need not rush to take notes.

blocks.zh: 李文：不仅数字教室很方便，现在网上到处是学习资料，想查什么都能查到，自学也更方便了。
blocks.en: Li: Besides digital classrooms, learning materials are everywhere online, making information searches and self-study easier.

blocks.zh: 白家月：是的，只要有手机或电脑，我就是不在教室，也可以学习中文，和同学一起练口语。
blocks.en: Bai: With a phone or computer I can study Chinese and practise speaking with classmates even outside the classroom.

blocks.zh: 安妮：科技真是让获取知识变得简单多了。
blocks.en: Annie: Technology makes acquiring knowledge much simpler.

blocks.zh: 李文说，线上上课时，如果没听懂，课后还可以怎么做？
blocks.en: What can you do after an online class if you did not understand?

answers.zh: 可以在学校网站上找到视频记录看。
answers.en: Watch the recording on the school website.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

blocks.zh: 人们自学为什么变得越来越方便了？
blocks.en: Why is self-study becoming easier?

answers.zh: 因为网上到处是学习资料，想查什么都能查到。
answers.en: Learning materials and information are widely available online.

blocks.heading: Book practice · 3

sections.intro: 就是……也…… expresses “even if” in spoken Chinese; the second clause stays true despite an extreme condition.

sections.title: Text 3

blocks.zh: 今天星期六，我们去了一雪姐姐家。姐姐家的两个孩子很有礼貌，我们一进门，就马上和我们打招呼。
blocks.en: Today, Saturday, we visited Yixue. Her two children greeted us politely as soon as we entered.

blocks.zh: 在姐姐家，我们也聊到了孩子的教育。姐姐说，以前他们和很多家长一样，觉得孩子上个好大学，人生才是成功的。所以，他们只关心孩子的分数，结果孩子压力特别大，每天都很不开心。后来，他们认识到，教育的目的不是让孩子考高分，而是帮助孩子养成好习惯。于是，他们做出改变，每天都给孩子留出时间外出锻炼身体，或者看些自己感兴趣的书。
blocks.en: We discussed children’s education. Like many parents, they once thought success meant attending a good university. Focusing only on scores made the children stressed and unhappy. They later realised education should develop good habits rather than merely high marks. They changed, leaving time daily for exercise or books the children enjoyed.

blocks.zh: 我觉得他们的做法真棒。
blocks.en: I think their approach is excellent.

blocks.zh: 以前，王一雪的孩子为什么不开心？
blocks.en: Why were Wang’s children unhappy before?

answers.zh: 因为家长只关心分数，孩子压力很大。
answers.en: Their parents focused only on scores, causing great pressure.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

blocks.zh: 王一雪和刘明做出了什么样的改变？
blocks.en: What changes did Wang and Liu make?

answers.zh: 他们每天给孩子留时间锻炼身体或看自己感兴趣的书。
answers.en: They left time each day for exercise or enjoyable reading.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

sections.note: Retell this text in your own words

prompt.zh: 星期六，白家月和李文去了……。王一雪的两个孩子……，他们一进门，两个孩子就……。在王一雪家，他们也聊到了……。王一雪说，以前他们……，觉得孩子……，人生才是成功的。所以，他们只关心……，结果孩子……，每天都……。后来，他们认识到，教育的目的不是……，而是帮助孩子……。于是，他们……，每天都给孩子……外出锻炼身体，或者看些……。白家月觉得王一雪和刘明的做法……。
prompt.en: On Saturday Bai and Li visited…. The children were…and greeted them…. They discussed…. The parents once thought…and focused on…, making the children…. They later realised education should not…but…. They changed by giving time for…and…. Bai thought their approach….

answer.zh: 星期六，白家月和李文去了王一雪家。两个孩子很有礼貌，马上和他们打招呼。他们聊到了孩子的教育。以前王一雪和刘明只关心分数，觉得上好大学才是成功的，结果孩子压力很大。后来，他们认为教育不是让孩子考高分，而是帮助孩子养成好习惯。他们每天给孩子留时间运动或读喜欢的书。白家月觉得这个做法很棒。
answer.en: Bai and Li visited Wang on Saturday. The polite children greeted them. They discussed education: the parents had focused on scores and university success, causing stress. They later valued good habits, allowing time for exercise and enjoyable reading. Bai approved.

sections.title: Grammar 3 · 不是……而是……

blocks.zh: 教育的目的不是让孩子考高分，而是帮助孩子养成好习惯。
blocks.en: Education aims to develop good habits rather than just high scores.

sections.title: Text 4

blocks.zh: “学而不厌”是两千多年前中国教育家孔子说过的话，意思是人要一直坚持学习，就是说，学习是人一生的事情，要活到老学到老。在世界快速变化的今天，“学而不厌”变得更加重要。
blocks.en: Confucius spoke of tireless learning over two thousand years ago: learning is lifelong. In today’s rapidly changing world this matters even more.

blocks.zh: 我有一位很优秀的律师朋友，他一直在学习新的法律知识。他说，这不仅是律师的要求和责任，也是提高自己能力的重要方法。
blocks.en: An excellent lawyer friend continually studies new legal knowledge. It is both a professional responsibility and an important way to improve his abilities.

blocks.zh: 同时我也认为，人就是不再工作了，坚持学习仍很重要。就像我爷爷，虽然七十多岁了，每天还准时去老年大学上课，学习做网页、弹钢琴。他说，重新当一回学生，生活更有意思了，也感觉自己变年轻了。
blocks.en: I also think continued learning matters even after retirement. My grandfather, in his seventies, attends senior university punctually to study webpage creation and piano. Becoming a student again makes life more interesting and makes him feel younger.

blocks.zh: “活到老学到老”是什么意思？
blocks.en: What does “never too old to learn” mean?

answers.zh: 学习是一生的事情，人要一直坚持学习。
answers.en: Learning is lifelong and we should keep learning.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

blocks.zh: 那位律师为什么一直坚持学习法律知识？
blocks.en: Why does the lawyer keep studying law?

answers.zh: 这是工作的要求和责任，也是提高能力的方法。
answers.en: It is a professional duty and a way to improve his abilities.

blocks.zh: 你喜欢老师怎样上课？请根据你的经历，写一篇短文，说说你喜欢的课堂教学方式，并说明理由，不少于140字。
blocks.en: Describe your preferred teaching style and explain why, based on experience, in at least 140 Chinese characters.

answers.zh: 我喜欢老师先介绍今天要学的内容，然后让我们一起练习。遇到不懂的地方，老师可以举一些生活中的例子，这样我更容易听明白。我也喜欢和同学一起讨论，因为大家的想法不一样，我能从他们那里学到很多东西。数字教室很方便，课后我可以再看视频记录，但是我仍然希望有机会在线下和老师交流。对我来说，好的课堂不是老师一直说、学生一直听，而是大家都有机会提问题、练口语。即使开始时说得不好，我也会认真参加。我觉得这样的学习更有意思，也能帮助我养成主动学习的好习惯。
answers.en: I like teachers to introduce the material and then let us practise. Everyday examples clarify difficult points. Class discussions expose me to different ideas. Digital recordings are convenient, but I still value in-person contact. A good class gives everyone opportunities to ask questions and speak rather than only listening. I participate even when my speaking is imperfect. This approach is engaging and develops active learning habits.
